Indeed sponsored jobs appear at the top of search results for relevant candidates.

The Torre Show returns on Friday and Wednesday with new episodes.
The Torre Show is distributed by DCP Entertainment.
Ryan Woodhall is an editor for The Torre Show.
Saying 'I heard about Indeed on this podcast' is required to claim the sponsorship offer.
Chuck Marcus and Shanta Covington are photographers for The Torre Show.
Claudia Jean is a booker for The Torre Show.

assumptions.text: Audiences trust recommendations made within podcasts they listen to.
Business owners who hear the ad believe they urgently need to hire talent.
Sponsored listings on job boards are a credible and effective recruitment strategy.
Increased application volume correlates with better candidate quality.
Listeners perceive value in supporting sponsors through direct action like visiting a URL.
Listeners are capable of following simple instructions like visiting a website and entering a code.
The speaker has authority over the production team and their contributions are accurate.
The claim about 45% more applications is based on trustworthy internal data.
The phrase 'the man can't shut us down' implies resilience and ongoing relevance, which builds credibility.
Promoting Indeed through the podcast enhances the show’s perceived value to its audience.
